run_label: held-out test, local graders (AI off), after all fixes

benchmark.provenance: Synthetic benchmark authored by an AI agent acting as an independent teacher, labelled once with a self-review pass. NOT teacher-validated. Use for regression testing and relative comparison of grading engines, not as a claim of real-world accuracy. HELD-OUT TEST split: only the final evaluation step may open this file; do not use it to develop or tune the grader.

config.thresholds_mode_note: engine: grade_answer(th=None) -> engine.default_thresholds(scorer); settings: Settings tau/tau_low/contradiction_threshold for every scorer (as pipeline.processor._thresholds); per-grader values are under graders[].thresholds

bootstrap.unit: answer (key points resampled with their answer)
bootstrap.breakdown_groups: category/type groups carry CIs for error_rate_unflagged, flag_rate, kp_kappa, mae, qwk_normalised, within_0.5 only

method.ci_support: ci95_defined of ci95_resamples bootstrap resamples gave a defined value (e.g. a precision is undefined in a resample with no predicted positive); the CI uses only those (shown as 'd=NN%' when below 100%) and is n/a when fewer than 50% are defined
method.qwk_normalised: headline QWK: marks / max marks binned to 0.1 steps (ratings 0-10, round half up), pooled across questions; a constant fraction of the maximum scores 0. It still credits differences between questions, and on questions worth more than 5 marks two adjacent half marks can share a bin
method.qwk_per_question_mean: unweighted mean of QWK within each question on its own 0.5-mark scale, over questions with >= 5 answers whose expected marks are not all equal (gold-only rule, the same questions for every grader); n = number of such questions
method.qwk_absolute_pooled: QWK on absolute marks binned to 0.5-mark steps, pooled across questions: scale-confounded (predicting max/2 for every answer scores above 0); 'qwk' is the same value under its old name. Quarter-mark labels round half up on the 0.5 grid
method.pearson: pearson_normalised is on marks / max marks; 'pearson' is on absolute pooled marks (scale-confounded)
method.kp_kappa: Cohen's unweighted kappa, expected vs predicted key-point status
method.awarded: key point awarded = matched or partial
method.false_contradiction_rate: share of key points not expected 'contradicted' that were predicted 'contradicted'
method.flag: routed to needs_review by pipeline.routing (perfect OCR/segmentation assumed)
method.error_rate_unflagged: share of incorrect answers among answers not flagged for review
method.calibration: ECE (10 equal-width bins), Brier and AURC of the routed confidence vs correctness; risk-coverage thresholds sit at distinct confidences (tied answers are accepted together, so the order of answers does not matter)
method.partial_credit_rule: matched = full weight, partial = half, missed = 0, contradicted = 0
method.errors: answers whose grader raised are excluded from metrics and counted in n_errors
